drivingQuestion: What is the reason behind R' Eliezer's permissions?
outcomeNote: Reasons supplied; Rav's question answered by R' Ḥiyya; Shmuel adds a leniency.

segments.he: מַאי טַעְמָא? מֶלֶךְ, מִשּׁוּם דִּכְתִיב: ״מֶלֶךְ בְּיׇפְיוֹ תֶּחֱזֶינָה עֵינֶיךָ״. כַּלָּה מַאי טַעְמָא — כְּדֵי שֶׁלֹּא תִּתְגַּנֶּה עַל בַּעְלָהּ. אֲמַר לֵיהּ רַב לְרַבִּי חִיָּיא: כַּלָּה עַד כַּמָּה? אֲמַר לֵיהּ, כִּדְתַנְיָא: אֵין מוֹנְעִין תַּכְשִׁיטִין מִן הַכַּלָּה כׇּל שְׁלֹשִׁים יוֹם.
segments.en: The Gemara asks: According to Rabbi Eliezer’s opinion, «what is the reason» that «the king» may wash his face? «Because it is written: “Your eyes shall see the king in his beauty”» (Isaiah 33:17). A king should always look regal before his nation. «What is the reason» that «a bride» may wash her face? «So that she should not» appear «repulsive to her husband.» Since it is only the beginning of their marriage, her husband may be disgusted at seeing her otherwise. «Rav said to Rabbi Ḥiyya: For how long» after her wedding is a woman considered «a bride? He said to him: As it was taught» in a baraita: If she becomes a mourner, «we do not prevent the bride from wearing perfumes» during «the entire» first «thirty days» of her marriage. This shows that for the first thirty days, her appearance is most critical.

segments.he: הַחַיָּה תִּנְעוֹל אֶת הַסַּנְדָּל — מִשּׁוּם צִינָּה.
segments.en: «A new mother» may «wear shoes.» What is the reason for this? «Due to the cold» there is concern that she will become ill, as she is weak from the birth.

segments.he: אָמַר שְׁמוּאֵל: אִם מֵחֲמַת סַכָּנַת עַקְרָב — מוּתָּר.
segments.en: «Shmuel said: If» a man is worried about walking barefoot on Yom Kippur «due to the danger of scorpions, he is permitted» to wear shoes, since one need not put himself in danger.
